1.title: Table 1. Samples, outcomes and identification roles
rows: Reported carbon-field capture; descriptive and contextual analysis
1.note: Notes: India: 160 treatment and 158 comparison plants; 24 initial-frame exclusions are examined separately. China: 22 treated and 58 comparison firms after recursive singleton removal from 89 balanced firms. The international contextual model uses 24,647 observations, 1,636 firms and 47 jurisdictions in 28 policy clusters. Sources: cited public archives, official roster, retrieved annual reports and supplied LSEG archive; own constructions.

2.title: Table 2. Randomized assignment effects on Indian reporting outcomes
2.note: Notes: 318 plants; original assignment; equal-weight means across 13 active windows; seven baseline covariates; HC2/t inference with 309 residual degrees of freedom. Availability and joint documentation use Holm-adjusted p-values for the two co-primary tests; hourly checks use nominal p-values. All intervals are marginal. The 1,000-kg cutoff is analytical, not a legal limit. Source: own secondary analysis of Greenstone et al. (2025b).

3.title: Table 3. Chinese implementation-period reporting contrasts
3.note: Notes: Principal model: 480 firm-years, firm, 2019-industry×year and province×year fixed effects; province-clustered inference with G/(G−1) × (N−1)/(N−k) adjustment and t critical values. Financial adjustment interacts 2019 log assets, leverage and profitability with year. Overlap weights target a different population; joint-estimation clustered inference is used without province×year effects. Wild p uses 9,999 null-restricted Rademacher draws. The separate 2020-baseline contrast appears in Table S12. Source: own calculations.

4.note: Notes: ESS = effective sample size (treated/comparison); SMD = standardized mean difference. Report-length interval is in log units. Drift calculation widens the principal interval by ±20 points, reflecting four years between the mean pre- and post-period dates. Independent explicit-dummy validation gives coefficient error below 3 × 10⁻¹⁵ and standard-error error below 2 × 10⁻¹³. Source: own diagnostics.

5.title: Table 5. International archive coverage in 2024
5.note: Notes: Rates refer to the supplied archive and the environmental-field-based sample; an absent field is not verified corporate non-disclosure. Scope 1–2 requires both reported fields.
